title: NSF Testing and Caffeine-Free Hydration
lessons: The player notices that select CELSIUS products carry NSF Certified for Sport testing.
The player already buys CELSIUS but chooses the caffeine-free Hydration line for situations where energy is not wanted.

text: The player notices that select CELSIUS products carry NSF Certified for Sport testing.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: That little NSF mark feels unusually serious for this can.

entry-first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Select products go through NSF Certified for Sport screening for substances prohibited by major athletic organizations.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So if I am not getting drug tested for sport?

entry-first-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then it may not be your main reason to care. For competitive athletes, it can matter a lot.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: Third-party testing makes me more comfortable.
I would still check whether this exact flavor is on the certified list.
I am not a tested athlete, so that seal does not decide the purchase for me.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Good. Outside verification should matter most when the risk matters to you.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Correct. Certification is product-specific. Check the current list.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: That is fair. A quality signal can be real without being personally important.
The player already buys CELSIUS but chooses the caffeine-free Hydration line for situations where energy is not wanted.

entry-return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Surprise. No caffeine.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: From you? Should I call someone?

entry-return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Very funny.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: What is the job then?

entry-return-5.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Electrolytes and hydration. Same brand, different reason to reach for it.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like that every can does not have to be an energy drink.
The brand name still makes me expect stimulation.
If I want hydration, I would rather buy a hydration brand.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Growth. Beautiful.

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: I know the branding makes it sound like I forgot my own personality.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: A little.

return-2-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: The label still has to tell you the job changed.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Reasonable. Putting my name on hydration does not mean you have to trust me for hydration.
